shared.name: Comb — Private Coupon Tester
shared.shortDescription: Test coupons with verified checkout restoration, trusted feed updates, and protected creator attribution.
shared.singlePurpose: Comb tests user-provided or signature-verified coupon codes on the current checkout and preserves the best measurable discount without changing creator affiliate attribution.

permissions.activeTab: Temporarily inspect the checkout only after the user invokes Comb on that tab.
permissions.alarms: Run best-effort update checks only for signed-feed sources the user explicitly connected.
permissions.scripting: Inject Comb's packaged coupon engine into the temporarily authorized active tab.
permissions.storage: Keep merchant coupon lists, trusted public keys, verified feeds, and approved-source settings on the device.
permissions.optional_host_permissions: Request one exact public HTTPS feed origin at runtime only after the user enters its URL and approves the browser prompt.

remoteCode.explanation: All executable JavaScript and CSS is packaged in the extension. Optional feeds are bounded signed JSON and cannot contain scripts, selectors, URLs, or executable configuration.

dataHandling.scope: The displayed payable total and currency only; no card, bank, billing-address, payment-token, or account fields.
dataHandling.purpose: Measure whether a coupon changed the amount shown by the checkout.
dataHandling.retention: Memory for the active run only.

dataHandling.scope: The current merchant hostname only when the user opens Comb; Comb does not request or read the browser history API.
dataHandling.purpose: Keep the user's coupon list scoped to the correct merchant.
dataHandling.retention: Extension-local storage until the user deletes the merchant or all local data.

dataHandling.scope: User-entered coupon tokens plus visible coupon-control labels, coupon-specific result messages, and the displayed payable total.
dataHandling.purpose: Find coupon controls, test the user's codes, verify removal, and report the result.
dataHandling.retention: Coupon tokens may remain in extension-local storage; checkout labels, messages, and totals remain in memory for the active run only.
recipients: The current merchant checkout receives only the coupon token that Comb enters into its existing visible coupon field.

optionalFeedNetwork.destination: Only the public HTTPS feed URL entered by the user and approved through the browser's origin prompt.
optionalFeedNetwork.requestData: A credential-free GET with no referrer, checkout URL, merchant history, coupon outcomes, creator tags, identity, or payment data.
optionalFeedNetwork.operatorVisibility: The user-selected feed operator can ordinarily observe the requested path, request time, IP address, and common transport/browser headers.

compatibilityReport.destination: A local JSON download selected by the user.
compatibilityReport.includedData: Comb version, timestamp, allowlisted adapter/reason, and coarse detection booleans only.
compatibilityReport.excludedData: Merchant URL/hostname, page content/selectors, coupon codes, totals/currency values, cookies, affiliate/referral tags, and creator identifiers.

creatorAttribution.publicMessage: The creator-tagging issue is fixed: Comb leaves existing creator affiliate tags, referral parameters, and cookies untouched so the original creator can keep proper attribution.

screenshots.caption: Comb testing coupon codes on a synthetic checkout while keeping creator attribution protected.
